text:
olivia: quick design sync — dropping a new Figma frame for the scorecard toolbar + contextual help for eval runs https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx — want eyes on accessibility, microcopy, and the compact/dense toggle.
kevin: saw it, looks cleaner. one thing: the tooltip contrast for the info icon is 3.5:1 on the light bg — needs to be 4.5:1 per WCAG AA.
maria: also keyboard flow: when you open a diff and hit tab, focus lands in the acceptance dropdown after the 'approve' button. expected behavior is focus stays in the toolbar first. can we reorder?
sanjay: +1 to maria. dev-side note: the approve CTA is primary on the right — that's uncommon. For keyboard users muscle memory, primary left feels faster. any product rationale for right-side primary?
olivia: we tried right-side to match route-level actions elsewhere, but i'm open to switching. maybe follow the existing pattern across evals.
alex: for aria, add `aria-haspopup="menu"` to the three-dot menu and explicit `aria-label` to the compact toggle: `aria-label="Toggle compact diff layout"`. also provide `aria-pressed` for the toggle state.
kevin: microcopy nits: tooltip text currently "Compact mode reduces visual noise" → suggest "Compact mode hides non-essential metadata for faster scanning." Softer claim about noise.
maria: for the score badge legend, the color-only legend is problematic for colorblind users. can we add icons or pattern hatch? even a small label like "Pass/Fail/Flaky" visible on hover would help.
olivia: good call. thinking tiny chevrons next to colors + label on hover.
sam-bot: visual-regression-check failed for frame: scorecard_toolbar_v3. Diff at /artifacts/scorecard_toolbar_v3.png.
sanjay: ugh, what changed?
alex: looks like spacing tweak — 6px -> 8px between toolbar buttons. That will flip some snapshots.
kevin: is spacing intentional? feels like we introduced more clickable area which helps touch but breaks compact density. can we make it conditional by a setting?
maria: accessibility tradeoff: bigger targets are good. maybe default to larger, but add a compact mode that reduces spacing for power users. Need clear affordance and keyboard label.
olivia: plan: revert spacing for snapshot, ship accessibility improvements (contrast, aria attrs), move approve CTA left to align with other flows, add legend icons, and update microcopy. I'll update the figma and post a new frame. Anyone object to rolling these into the next patch?
kevin: no objection from me.
sanjay: fine. also can we add a hidden live-region announcement when diff updates after a rerun? screen reader users need to know the result changed.
alex: yes — `role="status"` with a short message like "Eval run results updated: 3 changes". keep it brief.
maria: one last UX ask — make the 'review count' clickable and open a filtered view instead of the tooltip. people expect quick filtering.
olivia: noted. thanks everyone — i'll push an updated frame by EOD and tag you. :thumbsup:
kevin: thanks! :zap:
sam-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot update queued for PR #4312.
